messages.text: okay that fix should hold the line. next up: are we actually doing snapshots this week or are we waiting until Milestone 3 deadline looms?
i was thinking just log replication for now, but if Amara's injector runs long enough the logs get huge. 1000 entries per snapshot? seems reasonable to cap memory.
yes do it now. tests need it. if we wait until Friday we're going to have a meltdown when the disk fills up or the leader election times out because the log is 50mb long.
fair point. i'll add the InstallSnapshot RPC. do we send the whole state or just a diff? i'm leaning towards full state for simplicity since our key-value store is small.
full state is fine for now. diffing is too much work for this course project. just serialize the map, send it, done.
agreed. i'll trigger it when the log length exceeds 1000 and the leader has a stable state. follower applies it before catching up on new entries?
yes. follower truncates its log, applies snapshot, then processes AppendEntries as normal. standard raft flow.
wait, if the follower is far behind, do we send multiple snapshots or just the latest one? i think just the latest, assuming the log entries in between are not needed for state?
just the latest. if they missed intermediate writes, the snapshot should contain all those states. otherwise the state machine is inconsistent.
got it. i'm writing the RPC now. might take an hour to get the serialization right without blocking the main goroutine.
make sure you don't block election timeouts while serializing! that's a classic gotcha.
noted. i'll spawn a separate goroutine for the snapshot creation. thanks for the save, i would have missed that.
